title: Gluing data for prescribed local module families
statement: Let $X$ be a ringed topological space, with module sheaves as in [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Fix a universe containing its points and ring sections. For every open $U$ fix an index set $I_U$ in that universe and a family $B_{U,t}$ of $\mathcal O_X|_U$-module sheaves with sections in that universe. Define $D(X,I,B)$ to consist of a subset $\mathcal U\subseteq\operatorname{Op}(X)$ covering $X$, labels $t_U\in I_U$ for $U\in\mathcal U$, and isomorphisms $\varphi_{UV}:B_{U,t_U}|_{U\cap V}\xrightarrow{\sim}B_{V,t_V}|_{U\cap V}$ for all $U,V\in\mathcal U$, including equal pairs, satisfying $\varphi_{UT}|_W=\varphi_{VT}|_W\circ\varphi_{UV}|_W$ for every $U,V,T\in\mathcal U$ and open $W\subseteq U\cap V\cap T$. Restrictions retain the original section maps and module structures. No finiteness or separation hypothesis is part of this definition.
